name: Fibonacci Grid
desc: Two Fibonacci chains crossed into a quasiperiodic brickwork — every column and every row spaced long-short in the golden ratio, cutting the plane into four kinds of inlaid panel that each keep their own hatch discipline, sliding and flipping as the chains drift out of step.

energy.doc: shading contrast + joint weight + chiaroscuro depth

scale.doc: cell size vs frame (2.2 = a handful of huge panels)

density.doc: hatching ruled into each panel type

phason.doc: rate the two chains slide out of step, flipping whole rows and columns between long and short

x.doc: lattice origin x as canvas fraction

y.doc: lattice origin y as canvas fraction

style.doc: aesthetic: engraved marquetry inlay / cyan schematic on prussian / two-ink risograph / raking-light brutalist concrete / luminous additive panels on black (non-representational)
